description: Change the TEXT or CAPTION of a message already posted to a Telegram channel, group or chat — the fix for a typo that would otherwise cost the post AND its accumulated views, since deleting and reposting starts from zero. Pass `text` for a plain post or `caption` for one carrying media; Telegram refuses the wrong one and its error names the other. It overwrites the published text, and the previous wording is not kept. Free, 0 credits. Needs Telegram connected.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

buttons.description: URL buttons under the post. An edit REPLACES the buttons with what it sends, so pass them again to keep them; the reply reads back the buttons Telegram now shows.

caption.description: the new caption, for a post carrying a photo/video/album

chatId.description: the channel’s @username or numeric chat id

linkPreview.description: false to suppress the link preview

messageId.description: from post_to_telegram, or the number at the end of a t.me link

parseMode.description: 'HTML' to format the new text with Telegram's HTML tags; omit for plain text

text.description: the new text, for a post with no media

name: edit_telegram_message
title: Edit a Telegram post
